user_query: trass gmail with any term: shipBob, merchant, support, and NOT any: avask, mgm, canusa

intent.goal: find emails in trass gmail containing any of shipBob/merchant/support terms but excluding avask/mgm/canusa

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%shipBob%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%shipBob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipBob%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%merchant%'
    OR g.subject LIKE '%support%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%support%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%support%'
)
AND g.subject NOT LIKE '%avask%' AND g.body_snippet NOT LIKE '%avask%' AND g.message_content NOT LIKE '%avask%'
AND g.subject NOT LIKE '%mgm%' AND g.body_snippet NOT LIKE '%mgm%' AND g.message_content NOT LIKE '%mgm%'
AND g.subject NOT LIKE '%canusa%' AND g.body_snippet NOT LIKE '%canusa%' AND g.message_content NOT LIKE '%canusa%'
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 1200
